story_type: crewed moon rocket liftoff seen from a camera on the capsule
hook: This camera rode the outside of a Moon rocket at liftoff.
narration: This camera was bolted to the outside of Orion as the Artemis II rocket lit beneath it.
Four astronauts sat inside the capsule, just above this view.
It was six thirty-five in the evening on April first, 2026, at Kennedy Space Center.
The first white clouds are steam. Water floods the pad at ignition to soak up the heat and the sound.
Then the boosters lit, and the launch tower slid out of the frame.
[short pause] Within seconds, the whole launch pad was shrinking under a column of smoke.
outcome: Artemis II cleared the pad and sent its crew of four on their way around the Moon.
title: Artemis II liftoff from the capsule
description:
Launch Pad 39B falls away as Artemis II lifts off from Kennedy Space Center on April 1, 2026, seen from a camera on the outside of the Orion spacecraft carrying four astronauts.
